audit_metadata.method: Refresh pass: two parallel research agents (A: fresh full codebase re-scan, old-audit-claim diff/classification, technical-debt scan; B: live production re-verification of every RLS/ownership/security claim via the Supabase Management API against project enmosvippabmuqslzrox, plus a schema-reproducibility replay check) plus a from-scratch, 20-transition product-flywheel trace done directly, not delegated. All disposable test rows created during live verification were deleted afterward and confirmed back to pre-test row counts.
audit_metadata.not_verified: The actual Anthropic model-call success path for any AI feature (ai-concierge, create-assistant, business-ai-assistant) was still not exercised end-to-end — this sandbox cannot mint a real signed-in session's bearer token. No manual device/simulator run was performed for any UI flow.

changes_since_last_audit.new_regression_found_and_fixed_during_th: supabase/migrations/20260809_social_invite_community_join.sql duplicated a policy already baked into the baseline, breaking a from-scratch migrations-folder replay; found via live catalog cross-check and a real Docker replay, fixed by archiving the file (git mv to migrations_archive/), re-verified with a clean replay

screens_count.notes: NoticesScreen.js (dead at last audit) is now deleted from the repo entirely. MatchesScreen.js has no route of its own by design (composed inline in InboxScreen.js); its previously-dangling RootNavigator.js import has been removed. Two screens are new since the last audit: RelationshipHubScreen.js, BusinessAIAssistantScreen.js.

Group chats (silent-send-failure bug fixed)
Activity feed (superseded NoticesScreen.js dead code now deleted)

Perk redemption, now with a real 6-digit proof-of-redemption confirmation flow

Consumer Premium subscription via RevenueCat

AI Create Assistant, AI Concierge, AI Rehearsal Room

all confirmed correctly deployed and structurally sound (ownership gates, rate limits, verify_jwt all live-checked) but no real Anthropic call has ever been exercised end-to-end in any documented session
still a client-side filter over already-fetched lists, unchanged

Withdraw action for a pending host-approval gathering request

technical_risks: Two-now-three large (1200-1400+ line) single-file screens carrying significant business logic (GatheringsScreen, ChatScreen, and now BusinessDashboardScreen)
Hardcoded backend URLs/keys inline in 15 files total, not 3 — a larger cleanup surface than previously known
Inconsistent admin-action integrity patterns (RPC vs. plain client update within the same screen), confirmed unchanged
Client-side, non-indexed search that will not scale gracefully with data volume growth
Deliberately wide-open RLS on gatherings/communities row visibility (narrower now that join-time enforcement exists, but row-visibility RLS itself is unchanged)
No environment-config layer; every hardcoded value in the app is a plain source-code string
Two small, newly-found dead-code items (ActivityBell.js, a stray duplicate services directory)
